title: Letter Category · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Letter Category · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a letter and a broad category together. The lead names two different examples in the category that begin with that letter. Both answers fit the category and start with the selected letter. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Letter Category, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
Both answers fit the category and start with the selected letter.
recall.why: Both answers fit the category and start with the selected letter.
